headline: European Prosecutors Arrest Three Across Three Nations in Alleged €23 Million AirPods V.A.T. Carousel Tied to €195 Million ‘Midas’ Probe
deck: At the request of the E.P.P.O. in Munich, police and tax investigators detained suspects in Bulgaria, the Netherlands, and Poland over suspected cross-border missing-trader trades in Apple earbuds. All suspects are presumed innocent.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: EPPO Munich announced three arrests across Bulgaria, the Netherlands, and Poland in an alleged €23M (~$25M) German VAT carousel involving AirPods traded through German and Bulgarian missing traders, part of the wider €195M Investigation Midas probe; suspects presumed innocent.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: If proven, the allegations would resemble collecting €2,300 in sales tax on retail headphones and vanishing before filing a return
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Immediate tax audit freeze, asset seizure, and prosecution for aggravated tax evasion

sources.title: Investigation Midas: Three arrests in Bulgaria, the Netherlands and Poland in probe into multimillion VAT fraud

interactive_art_spec.caption: The Neo-Baroque Palace of Justice (Justizpalast) in Munich at dusk. European prosecutors in Munich coordinated arrests and searches across Bulgaria, the Netherlands, and Poland in the €195 million Investigation Midas V.A.T. probe.
